name: Koisuru Kaizoku Legend
original_name: 恋スル海賊レジェンド
source:
You are a princess of a small country which belongs to the Yamato Commonwealth. Yamato is known to have hidden the ruins of an ancient civilization. It falls under control of a powerful country, Saint Cross, and you are almost forced to have an arranged marriage with its third prince Lorenzo! However, the true intention of Saint Cross is to acquire the “Gardiner’s Trove”, a weapon of the old ages hidden in Yamato, for military use. It is said that the casket of the Trove can be opened only by you. You and your personal bodyguard, Nagisa, run away from your castle in order to keep from handing over the Trove.
Who are you going to join hands with? Pirates? Or the navy...?

[from [url=http://shallwedate.jp/en/paid/paid_008.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你是大和联邦某个小国的公主。传说大和隐藏着古代文明的遗迹。如今，强大的圣十字王国控制了这里，你几乎被迫与其第三王子洛伦佐政治联姻！然而，圣十字的真正目的是取得隐藏在大和的古代武器“园丁宝藏”，将其用于军事。据说只有你能打开宝藏的箱子。为了不把宝藏交出去，你和贴身护卫渚逃离了城堡。

你要与谁携手？海盗，还是海军……？

[来自 [url=http://shallwedate.jp/en/paid/paid_008.html]官方网站[/url]]
